title: Near-Doubles: One More Than a Double
objective: Derive a fact one more than a known double by adding 1 to the double's answer (e.g. 6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + 1).
studentQuestion: Is there a double hiding close to this problem?
newIdea: Using a known double as a stepping stone to a nearby, unmemorized fact.

teaching.see: Is one of these numbers part of a double you already know?
teaching.break: Rewrite 7 as 6 + 1 (recognizing 6+7 as double 6, plus one more).
teaching.transform: 12 + 1 = 13 — same value as 6 + 7, reached via a known double.

mastery.evidence: Correctly derives 2 near-double-plus-one facts from a known double.
